purpose: Same-session A100 comparison of shape-identical 64x64 and 128x128 CTA policies before any tile dispatch.
hardware_gate: Run complete output, canary, input-immutability, same-source ptxas bitwise, baseline ptxas bitwise and poisoned-graph checks for every candidate before timing. Require stable >=2% paired win in every round against the fastest admissible existing configuration on the exact shape/dtype. Any tile64 dispatch entry remains disabled if tile128 is faster.
resource_gate: Retain SASS and cubin hashes, HMMA controls, post-HMMA drains, registers, local memory and per-method launch geometry. Require HMMA8 and drain15.
performance_scope: Isolated GEMM timing only; does not prove whole-training gains or cuBLAS/cuBLASLt superiority.
